data.title: 灰姑娘 · 银雪高贵兔女郎镜前翘首迷离
data.description: 私密镜廊套房的落地水晶巨镜前，灰姑娘身着银白色高开叉亮面连体兔女郎装。头戴透明水晶兔耳，双手扶在镜面冰凉的玻璃上支撑身体，镜中映出她泛红的眼角与微张的樱唇，平日的傲岸在热浪中尽数化为温驯沉沦。
data.location: 水晶宫殿私密套房落地镜前
data.action: 双手扶镜回首，兔女郎紧身装勾勒完美背臀曲线，眼神迷离
data.lighting: 幽蓝地灯与水晶镜面的折射冷暖光交织
data.camera: cowboy shot, from behind, looking over shoulder
data.promptProse: Pressing her palms against the cool glass of the floor-to-ceiling mirror, her silver lacquered bunny suit gleams beneath the room's crystal sconces. Her crimson eyes glisten over her shoulder in breathless, unshielded surrender.
data.animaCaption: She leans against the large mirror in her silver bunny suit, looking back with a deep blush.
